facts.answer: The capital of India is New Delhi.
The capital of France is Paris.
The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
The capital of the United States is Washington, D.C.
The capital of the United Kingdom is London.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
Mars is called the Red Planet because iron minerals in its soil give it a reddish color.
Saturn is best known for its bright rings, which are made mostly of ice and rocky particles.
The Sun is the star closest to Earth.
The Sun is the star at the center of our solar system. Earth and the other planets orbit it.
The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite.
At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
Water's chemical formula is H2O: each molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
Photosynthesis is the process plants use to convert light energy, water, and carbon dioxide into sugars and oxygen.
Gravity is the attraction between objects with mass. Earth's gravity keeps us and the atmosphere on the planet.
Python is a general-purpose programming language known for readable syntax and a large ecosystem of libraries.
Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
HTML is the markup language used to structure content on web pages.
A CPU, or central processing unit, executes instructions and coordinates many of a computer's operations.
HTTP is the protocol browsers and servers use to exchange web requests and responses.
Artificial intelligence is a broad field focused on computer systems that perform tasks such as perception, prediction, and language processing.
A common model counts seven continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, and South America.
There are eight recognized planets in our solar system.
In a vacuum, light travels at about 299,792 kilometers per second.
